name: Aartech Solonics Ltd
title: Aartech Solonics Ltd - 542580 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Small, debt-light energy-equipment firm (FY26 revenue ~Rs 40 cr, 12-15% organic growth) with no capacity or utilisation disclosure, vague guidance and an order book of only Rs 10 cr at year start, so the supply-side read is thin.

triggers.label: Order book Rs 10 cr → Rs 25 cr by June
triggers.quote: by the end of June, we are expecting that our order book should come to somewhere around Rs. 25 crores.

triggers.label: Control & relay panel exports to China and Africa
triggers.quote: We were able to export them to China and Africa. And this is just the starting point

triggers.label: New Narmadapuram plant, ops early next year
triggers.quote: we are expecting our first operations to begin by early next year.

guidance.quote: by the end of June, we are expecting that our order book should come to somewhere around Rs. 25 crores.
the market potential looks somewhere around 50 to 100 crores.
commercial operations are targeted by the end of 26-27 or early 27-28.

red_flags.label: Negative operating cash flow, working-capital heavy
red_flags.quote: there are periods which are cyclical in nature where the cash generated from operations do show us a negative number.

red_flags.label: Repeated evasion on financial trajectory and export share
red_flags.quote: it practically looks very difficult considering the present situation.

evasions.quote: we don't like to throw a lot of numbers trying to make things look very attractive.
it practically looks very difficult considering the present situation.
We believe very clearly and strongly that innovation is the leverage
